what_to_test:
Juggle Dude 1.1.0 (33) — leaderboard wording update

This build clarifies the leaderboard rules, profile visibility and Apple/email sign-in wording in all five languages. Counting and ranking behavior are unchanged from build 32.

• Check Home, Leaderboard → Rules and Profile → Edit profile. Scores are automatic; recordings stay on your phone.
• Join the leaderboard and record while signed in. After syncing, the longest counted streak should rank, while total touches remain in session history.
• Try runs separated by a clear hand stop or ground bounce. Check the initial hand release and a new run after an interruption.
• Try Apple sign-in, email sign-in and guest mode, then change language without restarting.
• Check recording, replay, saving videos and Pro access.

English, German, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese are included. Touch-review submissions and the separate replay-editor upgrade remain postponed.
